short.q: Why are experiments not enough without a review?
short.model: Without a review there is no visible decision, so examiners cannot see selection or reflection.

short.q: List three ways to develop a drawing.
short.model: Change the medium, change the composition or viewpoint, and change the scale or crop to a detail.
points: a third valid way (crop, colour scheme, mixed media)

short.q: Explain how to present a page of experiments.
short.model: Group related tests in order, label each with materials and technique, and add a short review of what worked.

short.q: Why is a plan useful before the final outcome?
short.model: A design drawing, colour plan, materials list and time plan reduce risk and let you realise your intentions.

short.q: Why should you photograph work carefully?
short.model: The portfolio is submitted digitally, so poor lighting or focus hides the quality of the work and loses marks.
